annotations.title: Get sowing windows and care tasks

description: Upcoming sowing/transplant windows computed from the user's plant catalog and the garden's frost dates, plus zone, frost dates, and any due care tasks (watering/fertilizing, with a rain-skip hint). Use for "what should I plant/start/transplant and when" and "what care is due".

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.
